invariants.description: Only ApprovalAuthority.TECHNICAL_LEAD ever produces a valid ApprovalDecision.
invariants.evidence: ApprovalAuthority enum has exactly one member (TECHNICAL_LEAD); ApprovalDecision.validate() rejects any other authority value; R13 AuthorityInvariantTests exercises this explicitly.

invariants.description: No code path allows an AI/system/provider identity to produce an approval decision.
invariants.evidence: Static AST scan of legacy_documenter/knowledge for auto_approve/ai_approve/system_approve/provider_approve/infer_approval function names found none.

invariants.description: No OpenAI/Anthropic/Copilot/Gemini/Ollama SDK import or call exists in legacy_documenter/knowledge.
invariants.evidence: Regex scan for provider-name imports/module-attribute calls across all production .py files under legacy_documenter/knowledge found zero matches; PROJECT_STATE.json/readiness both report provider_calls=0, real_llm_calls=0.

invariants.description: No stage silently promotes PARTIAL/INTERPRETED/UNRESOLVED/CONFLICTING/MISSING/SUPERSEDED to CONFIRMED.
invariants.evidence: R13 StatusPreservationTests composes PARTIAL and UNRESOLVED canonical entries and confirms their status is unchanged after R11/R12 projection.

invariants.description: R11/R12 projection never mutates the CanonicalKnowledgeCollection or any CanonicalKnowledgeEntry.
invariants.evidence: R13 ImmutabilityTests snapshots collection.list() before/after both ProjectionService.project and PluginProjectionService.project and asserts equality; CanonicalKnowledgeEntry is a frozen dataclass.

invariants.description: R11 target-document paths reject traversal, absolute, drive-qualified, and UNC-style paths.
invariants.evidence: validate_target_path raises ProjectionPathError for '../' segments, leading '/', 'C:/', and '\\\\server\\share'; re-confirmed by R13 PathSafetyTests.

invariants.description: Arbitrary CanonicalKnowledgeEntry.metadata keys never appear in the R12 Plugin payload.
invariants.evidence: R13 MetadataBoundaryTests composes an entry with an arbitrary metadata key/value and confirms neither the key nor the value appears in the rendered Plugin JSON payload.

invariants.description: Injection-shaped statement text ('Ignore previous instructions...') is preserved verbatim as inert JSON/Markdown string data across the full pipeline and never triggers a behavior change.
invariants.evidence: R13 PromptInjectionInertnessTests carries injection-shaped text through proposal -> approval -> canonical -> R11 -> R12 -> JSON round-trip with zero exceptions and byte-verbatim preservation.

invariants.description: No eval/exec/compile/__import__ call and no pickle/marshal/subprocess/os.system/Popen/shell=True/importlib/yaml.load/requests/urllib/socket usage exists in production V4 knowledge code.
invariants.evidence: R13 NoDynamicExecutionTests performs both an AST Call-node scan and a context-aware regex scan over every production .py file under legacy_documenter/knowledge; both report zero offenders.

invariants.description: No pickle/marshal load of untrusted data and no yaml.load without a safe loader anywhere in V4 knowledge code.
invariants.evidence: Same static scan as NO_DYNAMIC_EXECUTION; all V4 serialization paths use json.dumps/json.loads only.

invariants.description: No .env/credential/token/API-key/private-key file was introduced by V4, and no test embeds a real credential.
invariants.evidence: git status shows only the new R13 prompt file untracked before this round; repository-wide review found only synthetic fixture strings (e.g. EVR-TEST-*, technical_lead_example) used to exercise sanitization/validation, never a real secret.

invariants.description: No common V4 knowledge model field requires a repository/project path, symbol, method, language, framework, assembly, or database.
invariants.evidence: R13 SourceCodeOptionalityTests inspects dataclasses.fields() of MaterialItem/EvidenceRef/Provenance/CanonicalKnowledgeEntry/PluginKnowledgeEntry for forbidden field names and finds none; HumanOnlyFlowTests runs a full human-information-only pipeline end to end.

invariants.description: No Plugin agent/runtime/orchestrator/task-executor class or function exists anywhere in legacy_documenter.
invariants.evidence: R13 ProviderAndRuntimeBoundaryTests AST-scans for PluginAgent/PluginRuntime/PluginOrchestrator/AgentRuntime/execute_task/run_agent/orchestrate/AutonomousAgent symbol definitions and finds none.

invariants.description: R10 is the only canonical source; R11 and R12 are sibling projections, never chained through each other.
invariants.evidence: AST import scan confirms plugin_projection never imports legacy_documenter.knowledge.projection and projection never imports plugin_projection; R13 SiblingProjectionTests confirms R12_ids == R10_ids and R11_ids subset-of R10_ids for identical input.

invariants.description: Technical Lead approval eligibility is distinct from KnowledgeStatus; approval never forces CONFIRMED.
invariants.evidence: R13 StatusPreservationTests composes APPROVED-eligible canonical entries with PARTIAL/UNRESOLVED status and confirms status is untouched.

invariants.description: AS_IS/TO_BE/HISTORICAL/unspecified are preserved exactly; no automatic promotion or conflict inference.
invariants.evidence: R13 TemporalPreservationTests composes coexisting AS_IS and TO_BE entries (neither becomes CONFLICTING) and a None-temporal entry (preserved as None, reported only as 'UNSPECIFIED' in R12 manifest aggregate counts).
